sv.title: Kunde knappt gå 100 meter – nu har han gått över 100 mil
sv.summary: När 81-årige Göran Lande flyttade in på sitt äldreboende i våras mådde han så dåligt att han hade börjat planera sin egen begravning. Han orkade knappt gå hundra meter. – Det var flera diagnoser: hjärtsvikt, njursvikt, lunginflammation, astma, diabetes...

en.title: Could barely walk 100 metres – now he has walked over 1,000 kilometres
en.summary: When 81-year-old Göran Lande moved into his care home last spring, he felt so unwell that he had started planning his own funeral. He could barely walk a hundred metres. "There were several diagnoses: heart failure, kidney failure, pneumonia, asthma, diabetes..."
